{{Top|leg}}
'''Reflective shielding''' was a form of [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] was constructed of [[Sandrock/Legends|sandrock]] reinforced with reflective shielding and [[Ditanium/Legends|Ditanium]] plating.
